blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Senior citizens at the Por Cristo Foundation Inc. and elderly persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) at the Butuan City Jail received health kits, medicines, food packs, and other essentials on Thursday in observance of Elderly Filipino Week. Personnel from government agencies, led by the City Social Welfare and Development Department (CSWDD), visited both facilities to deliver health supplies and welfare services addressing the daily health needs of the elderly. Participating agencies included the National Commission of Senior Citizens, Department of Social Welfare and Development, Department of Health, Department of Trade and Industry, and the Philippine Health […]...
